name: Tortang Talong
assumptions: Yield of 4 servings estimated from 4 eggplants (1 per serving) as a main dish component.
Total time ~30 min: ~10 min grilling, ~5 min cooling/peeling/flattening, ~5 min egg prep, ~10-15 min frying (3-4 min per side, likely sequential).
Vegetarian confirmed by source and ingredients (eggs used, no meat).
Pescatarian true as compatible with vegetarian plus fish but none present.
Gluten-free true: no barley, rye, wheat, or oats; all ingredients compatible.
Dairy-free true: no milk or dairy products.
No milk, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soy, or sesame in ingredients.
Eggs allergen present from listed eggs.
Olive oil treated as generic; no sesame or other allergens assumed.
Salt is plain table salt with no additives.
instructions:
0.	Grill the eggplant until the color of skin turns almost black
1.	Let the eggplant cool for a while then peel off the skin. Set aside.
2.	Crack the eggs and place in a bowl
3.	Add salt and beat
4.	Place the eggplant on a flat surface and flatten using a fork.
5.	Dip the flattened eggplant in the beaten egg mixture
6.	Heat the pan and pour the cooking oil
7.	Fry the eggplant (that was dipped in the beaten mixture). Make sure that both sides are cooked. Frying time will take you about 3 to 4 minutes per side on medium heat.

ingredients.name: Egg Plants
ingredients.assumptions: 4 medium eggplants, ~200g each raw with skin; grilled then peeled (edible flesh only).

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.assumptions: 4 tsp olive oil for frying (~4.5g per tsp).
